requirements.rationale: In src/index.ts (lines 5-6), the application mounts a router under the /api prefix. In src/routes.ts (lines 7-8), a rate limiting middleware is registered at the top of this router, ensuring that all sub-routes under /api are protected. The middleware itself is defined in src/middleware/rate-limit.ts (lines 11-34). It tracks requests using the client's IP address. When a client makes too many requests and runs out of capacity, the middleware sets a header named Retry-After with the calculated wait time and responds with an HTTP status code of 429.
requirements.why: token bucket, applied router-wide, 429 + Retry-After

requirements.rationale: In src/routes.ts, lines 8 to 19, the endpoint for retrieving notes implements cursor-based pagination. It extracts a page size parameter from the query string, defaulting it to twenty and capping it at a maximum of one hundred. It also extracts a cursor parameter representing the last seen record identifier. The database query retrieves records with an identifier strictly greater than this cursor, ordered by identifier, and fetches one extra record to determine if another page is available. The response includes the list of records and a field indicating the cursor for the next page, which is the identifier of the last record in the current page if more records are available, or null if there are no more pages.
requirements.why: keyset cursor via `after`, limit capped at 100, nextCursor returned
